montanaro.assumptions: A is coherent unitary state preparation on|0^n>,with access to Ainverse;output phi(x),bounded range or variance as required. State preparation,reversibility,reflections and data/oracle access have costs.
montanaro.amplitude_estimation: Prepared|psi>,projectorPgood,a=<psi|Pgood|psi>;U=2|psi><psi|-I,V=I-2Pgood. Theorem2.2error<=2*pi*sqrt(a(1-a))/t+pi^2/t^2 with success>=8/pi^2,using UandV ttimes each. Repeat/median increases confidence at extra logarithmic cost.
montanaro.mean_encoding: For phi in[0,1],controlled ancilla rotation encodes sqrt(phi(x));good-ancilla probability=sum_xPr(x)*phi(x)=E[phi]. General bounded-variance mean estimation has additional construction/logarithmic overhead,not simply arbitrary forecasting in1/epsilon.
montanaro.classical_comparison: Independent sampling mean variance sigma^2/N;fixed confidence additive error needs order sigma^2/epsilon^2 samples in the stated black-box setting. Near-quadratic quantum query reduction assumes the stronger coherent/inverse/oracle access. No classical-simulator wall-time conclusion.

qae_variants.canonical: QPE withm evaluation qubits,controlled Grover powers andinverse QFT;M=2^m,a_est=sin^2(pi*y/M). Q powers can be deep;discrete phase grid gives quantization/ambiguity. Counts of controlledQ,baseQ,A/Ainverse andprimitive gates must remain separate.
qae_variants.iterative: Qiskit Algorithms0.4.0 IQAE reference uses adaptive Grover powers without QPE;epsilon_target andalpha define precision/confidence,with beta(Clopper-Pearson) orChernoff interval options. Requires statistical assumptions andindependently verified implementation before support.
qae_variants.maximum_likelihood: MLAE0.4.0 uses an explicit Grover-power evaluation schedule andlikelihood minimization,no QPE evaluation register. Schedule,shot allocation,minimizer andconfidence convention matter;not the same estimator as finite-shot frequency.
qae_variants.source_sign_boundary: Montanaro reflection definitions andarchived Qiskit tutorialQ=A S0 Aadjoint Sgood use different stated sign conventions. Do not merge controlled-phase algorithms without checking signs/global phase;simple probability equivalence is insufficient for controlledQPE.
qae_variants.archived_tutorial_boundary: Finance0.4.1 is explicitly archived/unmaintained and uses the legacy qiskit.primitives.Sampler API. It is not a direct runtime proof for SDK2.6.2/SamplerV2. Its opening self-inner-product expression for a appears inconsistent with normalized states;this is our mathematical observation,not an author-issued erratum. Use the full prepared-state projection probability independently corroborated by Montanaro.

risk.mapping: R|0>=sum_i sqrt(pi)|i>;controlled F encodes f(i) in ancilla;success probability=sum_i pi*f(i). Distribution preparation,discretization,scaling andpayoff approximation are real assumptions/costs.
risk.objectives: Expected value/variance anddistribution-tail VaR/CVaR under a supplied model. CDF threshold estimation plus bisection supports VaR;conditioned expectation supports CVaR withadditional controls/normalization. Discrete mass/tail convention must be named before implementation.
risk.resources: Source two-asset example uses5distribution qubits;reportsm+12total forEV/VaR,m+13forCVaR. Approximation/depth trade-off permitsO(M^-2/3)at shallowconstruction,approachingO(M^-1)withgreater depth. These are source-theory/toy results,not our benchmark.
risk.limits: T-bill probability30% andrate-rise70%are assumed model inputs. Estimating prices/tail risk from known distributions is not empirical prediction of an unknown future market outcome. No finance dataset or circuits reproduced in this audit.

reproducibility_policy: Before production,freeze the local PRNG algorithm/version,seed,draw order and strict CDF comparison u<p. Seed equality does not guarantee equal counts across libraries. Proposed defaults are single-thread CPU,double precision and no automatic backend,noise or shot branching. Record source,plan,request and circuit hashes. Require exact JSON/Markdown and shot replay under a pinned environment;use separate tolerances for statevectors. No simulator or seeded shot counts were exercised in this audit.

performance_fairness.fair_comparison: A supplied known p has an exact O(1) classical reference. For sampling,compare equal p,N and declared random access;include matrix preparation overhead. Do not compare a classical algorithm denied p with a simulator using hardcoded p or cheaply collapsed RY powers while claiming advantage. Abstract Q^k query cost k and compiled single-rotation gate count are different resource measures.
performance_fairness.estimates: A packed complex128 statevector requires16*2^n bytes;four qubits use256bytes before Python/runtime overhead. Dense density matrices scale as16*4^n. Primitive gate evolution is O(G*2^n);Bernoulli terminal sampling is O(N). These are analytic storage/work bounds,not measured runtime or speedup.
